verdict.rationale: Remote is a global payroll and EOR platform, so configuring multiple pay schedules is a fair question for this product. The evidence only mentions payroll generally ("global payroll", "payroll inputs") and never documents weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, or monthly pay schedules, or assigning schedules to different teams.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can set up multiple pay schedules (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly) across different teams
